summary.title: Software Engineer | AI & Backend Systems
summary.text: Full-stack Software Engineer experienced in building scalable web and AI-powered systems. Skilled in Node.js, React, and AWS, with a track record of reducing costs, improving performance, and shipping production features used by thousands. Strong background in automation, backend architecture, and real-world product development.

list.text: AI & Data: LLM APIs, Automation, Data Analytics, MCP
Frontend: React, Vue, Browser Extensions, HTML/CSS
Backend: Node.js, REST APIs, OAuth2, JWT, Microservices
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), CI/CD, Docker

list.name: Medication Reminder System
list.description:
Built a real-time voice-automation system enabling healthcare providers to trigger AI-powered outbound calls for daily medication-adherence confirmation.
• Designed a RESTful API to initiate dynamic voice calls using patient-specific workflows.
• Engineered a real-time Text-to-Speech and Speech-to-Text pipeline integrating Twilio Voice, Deepgram (STT), and ElevenLabs (TTS).
• Implemented conversational call-flow logic with response parsing and status handling.
• Developed voicemail detection and automated SMS fallback for unanswered calls.
• Architected structured logging and call metadata storage for call status, recordings, and patient confirmations.
• Configured secure webhook handling and local tunneling with Ngrok for real-time call event processing.

• Developed and maintained full-stack web applications and backend services using Node.js, React, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
• Designed and implemented scalable REST APIs, authentication systems (OAuth2/JWT), and secure backend architectures.
• Integrated third-party services, AI-powered features, and AWS cloud infrastructure into production systems.
• Automated workflows and backend processes to improve system efficiency and reduce manual operations.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready features and enhance application performance and reliability.

• Reduced cost by 70% monthly and automated certain workflows.
• Implemented product features utilizing OAuth and APIs.

• Maintained and improved the production web application.
• Integrated Scribbl with two new meeting platforms: Microsoft Teams and Zoom.
• Conducted weekly Scrum meetings and followed Agile methodologies.
• Integrated a new GPT model into Scribbl’s AI chat feature.
• Implemented a global chat feature allowing users to interact with AI about all of their meetings.

• Developed and helped launch FluencerFruit.
• Designed user-friendly interfaces and implemented robust backend services for product searches and recommendations.
• Integrated advanced data analytics for actionable insights and performance tracking.
• Ensured scalability and performance for a growing user base.
• Conducted testing and debugging and implemented security best practices to protect user data.

• Utilized Chrome extension APIs, including storage and tabs, to improve user experience.
• Created RESTful APIs for secure backend communication and implemented AI models for automated chatbot responses.
• Developed a scalable Node.js backend for data processing and user authentication using OAuth 2.0 or JWT.
• Enhanced extension performance for efficient operation with large datasets.

• Managed web development projects from initial concept through final implementation.
• Built front-end and back-end applications using React, Angular, Node.js, and Python.
• Troubleshot complex development issues to improve system performance and reliability.
• Worked with clients, designers, and developers to translate requirements into functional applications.

BA in Computer Science, Rock Island, IL.
Relevant coursework: Coding in Python, Coding in Java, Data Structures, Software Development, Principles of Computer Systems, Calculus, Discrete Mathematics, Statistics, Algorithms & Computational Theory, Principles of Artificial Intelligence, Database Management, Data Engineering.
